scope: The inline tray chevron follows the spacing of the adjacent menu bar controls.

checks.command: Golden Gate KDE neon Plasma 6.8.1 Wayland VM: inspect the populated system tray with Panel Colorizer, capture before and after at the same scale, then click the chevron in light and dark appearances and inspect the expanded row.

Verify installed InlineTray.qml, PanelButton.qml and ControlStyle.js hashes against the approved candidate. Verify the recorded frame hashes and run python3 src/scripts/component_manifest.py in Tahoe.

approval: Maintainer requested release after reviewing the before-and-after spacing comparison for both editions.
coverage_limits: The focused capture exercised the shared panel implementation on Golden Gate under Wayland. A separate Tahoe session and X11 were not captured.
